title: List deals
description: Page through every deal in the portal.

config.label: Page size
config.description: How many records per page, 1 to 100. HubSpot's own default is 10.

config.label: After (cursor)
config.description: The cursor from the previous page's paging.next.after. Leave empty for the first page.

config.label: Properties
config.description: Comma-separated property names to return. HubSpot returns a small default set otherwise.

config.label: Associations
config.description: Comma-separated object types whose associated ids to return.

outputShape.description: HubSpot's deal id. A NUMERIC STRING, not a number; pass it back as given.
The requested properties, every value a string or null.
Pass this as "after" for the next page. Absent on the last page.
